item.title: Whiskers 0.8.42
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.42

### Live Dictation

  • Added faster cloud dictation for supported providers so spoken text starts appearing sooner while you talk
  • Improved live transcript handling so longer dictation sessions stay smoother and produce cleaner merged text

    • ### Recording & Updates

  • Fixed quick tap recordings so very short presses are handled more reliably instead of feeling missed or inconsistent
  • Improved update messaging so you can see when a newer build of the same version is available

    • ### App Icon

  • Refreshed the Whiskers app icon with the new brand mark
